original_test_intent: Verify six VR-zone temperature resources consistently across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with every zone's identity, description, reading, units, health and freshness bound to the correct regulator/rail board domain and SPEC.
original_method: Prove common target identity; obtain the six-zone regulator/rail topology; collect full command lists and all six Web rows in a bounded interval; exclude unrelated VR matches; normalize each zone's fields and compare to its component-specific limits without clearing logs or changing regulator, SDR or cooling state.
manual_activity: A power/platform reviewer approves each zone's regulator/rail/board membership and limits, then visually confirms the six Web rows and comparison.
safety_requirements: Do not change VR configuration, thresholds, phases or rails
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Map each zone to regulators/rails and aggregation
engineer_actions: Resolve missing, swapped or divergent zones

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal `TEMP_VR_Zone1~6` OOB read does not enumerate six zones, while generic `grep VR` can overmatch and truncated SDR omits required interfaces.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete lists and select six exact identities using the approved board map, then correlate all protected Web rows without changing VR controls.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The five-view/six-zone scope and timing metadata remain; generic clearing, overbroad grep acceptance and truncation are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a six-row matrix keyed by regulator/rail/board location, including aggregation rule, complete five-view fields, timestamps and per-domain limit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds electrical-domain identity and guards against generic VR grep overmatch.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Six plausible values can be reordered or associated with the wrong rail, producing a false thermal conclusion.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multi-phase or aggregate zones may not map one-to-one to a regulator; only the platform power SPEC may define membership.

project_override_considerations: Define each zone's regulators, rails, phases, board location, aggregation, fields, limits and tolerance. Private Script use requires a pinned reviewed revision.
expected_evidence: Power topology and six-zone mapping/aggregation matrix
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Six Web rows and page context
No-VR/SDR/thermal mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target six VR zones across five views. Generic clear and incomplete/overbroad DeepSeek collection are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Power map, aggregation, parsers, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if zone identities remain indeterminate after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Binds zone numbers to actual electrical thermal domains and prevents unrelated `VR` matches or one literal range request from passing the case.
independent_technical_reasoning: Regulator thermal significance depends on the rail, phase layout and placement; zones may aggregate several devices. Because numeric plausibility does not reveal electrical identity, per-zone topology and component-specific limits must anchor the five-view comparison.
